title: Ozonation System
model_title: Ozonation System (O₂ Feed, Ozone Generator, Diffuser Contactor, Off-Gas Destructor)

introduction.definition: An ozonation system produces ozone on site by passing oxygen through a corona discharge (3 O₂ → 2 O₃) and bubbles it into water through fine diffusers in a covered contact tank. Ozone is a very strong oxidant: it disinfects and removes colour, taste, odour and micro-pollutants. Leftover ozone in the off-gas is destroyed before venting.
applications: Bottled water, cooling water, wastewater reuse and pulp bleaching
key_points: Fine bubbles and depth give transfer

pressure.title: Strong oxidant, no lasting residual
pressure.description: Ozone is a very strong oxidant: it disinfects (including Cryptosporidium at higher C·t), removes colour, taste and odour, and oxidises iron, manganese and micro-pollutants. It is made on site because it decomposes quickly. Transfer into water depends on bubble size and contact depth; leftover ozone in the off-gas is destroyed before venting because it is toxic (workplace limits ~ 0.1 ppm).

video_tutorials.title: Ozonation System — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Ozonation System.
An ozonation system produces ozone on site by passing oxygen through a corona discharge (3 O₂ → 2 O₃) and bubbles it into water through fine diffusers in a covered contact tank.
Ozone is a very strong oxidant: it disinfects and removes colour, taste, odour and micro-pollutants.
Leftover ozone in the off-gas is destroyed before venting.
Typical applications include drinking-water oxidation and disinfection; bottled water, cooling water, wastewater reuse and pulp bleaching.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Ozonation System — Operation

script.narration: How the Ozonation System works.
Oxygen is supplied from LOX or a PSA unit.
Corona discharge in the generator forms ozone.
Ozone gas bubbles through ceramic diffusers.
Water flows under and over the baffles to get contact time.
The destructor converts off-gas ozone back to oxygen.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Ozone is a very strong oxidant: it disinfects (including Cryptosporidium at higher C·t), removes colour, taste and odour, and oxidises iron, manganese and micro-pollutants.

video_tutorials.title: Ozonation System — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Ozonation System.
Check ozone output, dew point of feed gas and residual.
Inspect dielectrics; check destructor.
Replace dielectrics/diffusers as needed.
Watch for low ozone output: low residual. Common cause: wet feed gas.
Watch for ozone leak: monitor alarm, smell. Common cause: gasket failure.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
